name: InstruSum
description: InstruSum is an evaluation-only dataset designed to benchmark large language models on instruction controllable text summarization, where models generate summaries based on both a source article and natural language instructions specifying desired summary characteristics. It assesses LLMs' instruction-following capabilities and evaluates automatic evaluation methods against human judgments.
reputation: A relatively new evaluation-only benchmark that is cited for probing instruction-following in summarization, but it has not yet reached the broad adoption of older summarization benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on instruction controllable summarization; includes human evaluation and multiple automatic evaluation protocols; highlights challenges in factuality and evaluation alignment.
